title: the chart chain splices berths from two voyages and BUILDME passes it
intention: The BUILDME entry lane a_berthed_chart_chain_claims_the_ticket refuses a chart chain whose standing stages are not one voyage (each stage is the berth its successor's <prior>_ref names), and refuses a chain whose validate is not the one the ticket's chart_claim names, when the claim names one.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on 4de7baf7e255: chain_for_ticket returned orient..survey from 20261113T1124 and decompose..validate from 20260906T11xx (an older plan); BUILDME crossed, and the hollow took its eligible set from the 09-06 decompose (ground_loop/sleep_cycle.py, system/*, tools/base/shim.py), none of which the 11-13 build 364dfb30f wrote, so it found no build commit and anchored at the BUILDME crossing: 'every one of the 1 eligible file(s) is byte-identical there'. Corpus-wide: 20 of 1016 charted tickets stand spliced; 7 claims name a validate other than the chain's.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof a hollow build couldn't pass — the splice blinded the hollow) and Law 4 (chain coherence is prose until the lane enforces it).
how: In buildme_rides_the_chart, after the claiming-validate search, read chain_for_ticket(ticket, berths_root=...) and walk the stages in order: for each adjacent pair whose both berths stand, the later packet's '<prior>_ref' must name the standing prior berth (compare by file name; a missing ref is not a break). If the ticket's chart_claim (state.json, else the ticket json) names a validate_berth, its file name must equal the chain's validate. Each break is one finding naming the ticket, the stage, the ref'd berth and the standing berth; disposition: re-chart (sail.py draft <id> <spec> --rechart). Red-first proof over a fixture berths root and fixture tickets.

clauses.claim: a fixture chain whose decompose..validate come from one voyage and orient..survey from a later one is refused by buildme_rides_the_chart with one finding naming decompose, the survey its ref names and the survey standing
a coherent fixture chain whose ticket's chart_claim names a different validate berth is refused with one finding naming both validate berths
a coherent fixture chain is green with a matching chart_claim validate_berth and with a chart_claim naming none

decisions.text: D1: buildme_rides_the_chart walks chain_for_ticket for ref coherence and compares chart_claim.validate_berth when present.
D2: the red-first proof builds fixture berths and tickets under a temp root, one tooth per clause.

After sail.py draft --rechart (commons eb3d02b8) the chain is one voyage (20261119T2057) and build_anchor reads first-build-commit 5dceee897 = 364dfb30f^.
